name: Dimly Lit Hallway
description: A long stone hallway stretches before you. Ancient tapestries line the walls, their colors faded with age. The air is cool and still.

exits.description: The wooden door leads back to the starting room.
The sound of commerce and bartering can be heard from a nearby market stall.
A barely noticeable path leads into some dense bushes.
The path opens up to what appears to be a peaceful village square.
